title: Identity integration & least-privilege walkthrough - BlueCrest Corp

SCIM provisioning / delta support and group mapping
RBAC role definitions and least-privilege model
Audit logs export, retention and SIEM integration

transcript:
Meeting header:
Date: 2025-12-02
Start: 15:00 PT
Duration: 58 minutes (approx)
Attendees: Sofia Patel (Redwood AE), Marcus Lin (Redwood SE), Lena Ortega (BlueCrest - Head of Security), Tomás Rivera (BlueCrest - Platform Engineer), Priya Shah (IT Ops), Erik Johansen (Director of Engineering)

Optional auto sections (brief):
Summary: Walkthrough focused on identity integration (SAML/SCIM) and RBAC least-privilege mapping. Covered cert rollover, SCIM delta, audit log exports, and KMS/BYOK considerations.
Topics: SAML attributes, SCIM group provisioning, RBAC role granularization, audit log retention, KMS/BYOK, data residency.

Transcript:
[00:00] Sofia (Redwood): hey everyone thanks for joining, um we'll run through SSO and SCIM best practices and then dive into how you might map groups to Redwood roles for least privilege. Marcus will cover the SCIM flows.
[00:18] Marcus (Redwood SE): hi, hi. quick note, if at any point the Okta names or Azure AD bits are off, call me out, transcription sometimes mangles audience URLs etc.
[00:30] Lena (BlueCrest): thanks, we're mainly on Okta today, we have strict audit requirements and need everything to support SOC 2 plus a pending ISO discussion.
[00:40] Erik (BlueCrest): timeline is tight, we want prod-ready SSO and deprovisioning by end of Q1.
[00:46] Sofia (Redwood): got it. quick qual: do you plan to use Redwood Hosted API or Private (VPC) for initial pilot?
[00:55] Tomás (BlueCrest): leaning private, at least for the first phase. data residency EU is required for some workloads.
[01:02] Marcus (Redwood SE): ok good, Private supports customer-managed KMS in our roadmap — we can discuss BYOK details. for SAML the usual attributes we expect are nameid (email), displayName, and groups. we also support sending an email attribute claim for mapping.
[01:20] Priya (BlueCrest): question: does your SCIM support group delta? we can't do full re-provision daily.
[01:30] Marcus (Redwood SE): yes, delta is supported, and we have POST /scim/v2/Groups and PATCH on the SCIM endpoint. caveat: some IDPs send nested group objects, occasionally the transcript uses 'G-R P cash' which is wrong — i mean K-V cache — sorry typo.
[01:50] Lena (BlueCrest): hah, ok. on RBAC, we want least privilege: separate billing, infra, deploy, ops, and view-only. how granular are Redwood roles?
[02:02] Sofia (Redwood): we have built-in roles: Org Admin (billing+config), Workspace Admin, Deployer (create/rollout), Observer (read-only), SRE (deploy/runbooks), plus custom roles via role templates. you can map SCIM groups to any of these or to a custom policy.
[02:20] Tomás (BlueCrest): do you support attribute-based access? like map by group name prefix?
[02:27] Marcus (Redwood SE): we support group-to-role mapping rules; currently it's simple mapping but we can accept regex-like matches in the mapping CSV for staged rollouts. not full ABAC yet, but we can scope via groups and nested groups.
[02:46] Erik (BlueCrest): deprovisioning is really important: if someone leaves, we need access cut immediately and audit evidence. what's your deprovisioning pipeline?
[02:55] Marcus (Redwood SE): SCIM remove -> immediate token revocation for API keys issued to that identity, and session force logout on web UI. we also record the event in audit logs as a user_deprovisioned event. note: some customers want a window for reactivation — we expose soft-delete flags.
[03:16] Lena (BlueCrest): retention on audit logs? we need 7 years for certain artifacts, but minimally 1 year online, then long term archived.
[03:26] Sofia (Redwood): default retention on hosted is 90 days in UI; for enterprise/Private we can push to your S3 or your SIEM (via syslog/webhook) for longer retention. for SOC2 evidence we can produce export bundles.
[03:42] Priya (BlueCrest): format? JSON events or something else?
[03:46] Marcus (Redwood SE): events are JSON, we provide both raw event stream and pre-shipped log-lines; for SIEM integration we support our webhook and syslog forwarding. S3 exports are gzipped JSONL with partitioning.
[04:00] Tomás (BlueCrest): can we get immutable logs? WORM storage?
[04:06] Sofia (Redwood): for Private, customers can use S3 with object lock/WORM. hosted we can retain but not WORM on a per-customer BY default; we can discuss an enterprise contract for stronger immutability guarantees.
[04:22] Erik (BlueCrest): encryption — at rest, in transit, and BYOK. what's your stance?
[04:28] Marcus (Redwood SE): TLS in transit everywhere; at-rest encryption using AES-256. for Private you can bring your key (BYOK) via KMS/HSM integration; currently we support AWS KMS CMKs customer-managed and have a roadmap for HSM direct wrap. there are constraints around tokenization and ephemeral keys for KV caches.
[04:52] Lena (BlueCrest): what about key rotation and cert rollover? we need to rotate every 90 days for SAML certs and keys.
[04:58] Sofia (Redwood): recent releases added automated SAML cert rollover with notification windows; for KMS keys rotation we support scheduled rotation if your KMS has lifecycle policies. for certs we recommend automating with Okta metadata refresh.
[05:12] Tomás (BlueCrest): Okta specifics: what exactly do you need from our side to do an initial test?
[05:18] Marcus (Redwood SE): a metadata XML or the IdP SAML metadata URL, the single sign-on URL (ACS) we'll provide, the audience URI (SP Entity ID) we'll provide. for SCIM we need a service account with bearer token and the base SCIM endpoint.
[05:36] Priya (BlueCrest): is provisioning bi-directional? like user profile sync back to Okta?
[05:42] Marcus (Redwood SE): not bi-directional; it's one-way SCIM from IdP to Redwood. you can push attributes (title, email, groups) to Redwood. we don't sync back to the IdP.
[05:54] Lena (BlueCrest): curious about SSO failover: if IdP is down, can we still allow emergency access?
[06:00] Sofia (Redwood): yes, we have emergency breakglass tokens and a secondary admin flow that requires multi-party approval. it's off by default; you'd request it as part of the Private onboarding and we can apply strict audit and time limits.
[06:15] Erik (BlueCrest): nice. about RBAC: do we get a policy simulator to test mappings?
[06:20] Marcus (Redwood SE): we have a role preview tool in Console that shows effective permissions per user before applying mapping changes. not super fancy ABAC but it's pretty clear. we'll demo that in the SCIM recording.
[06:36] Tomás (BlueCrest): sample mapping: we want group \"bluecrest:admin\" -> Org Admin, \"bluecrest:sre\" -> SRE, \"bluecrest:deploy\" -> Deployer. Any gotchas?
[06:46] Sofia (Redwood): watch out for overlapping roles — Org Admin supersedes others. best practice: avoid putting someone in both admin and deployer groups. enforce separation of duties: billing and ops separate.
[06:58] Priya (BlueCrest): what about service accounts? we often have CI/CD bots that need token-based access, separate from user SSO.
[07:04] Marcus (Redwood SE): service accounts are supported; they get API keys scoped by role. we recommend rotating keys frequently and storing them in your vault. we also support short-lived tokens via OIDC for ephemeral workflows.
[07:20] Lena (BlueCrest): audit evidence for SOC2: do you provide user activity timelines and configuration change logs?
[07:27] Marcus (Redwood SE): yes, we log config changes (who changed what), role assignments, SAML events (successful and failed logins), SCIM provisioning events. we can generate export for auditor review.
[07:40] Erik (BlueCrest): is there an admin activity report?
[07:43] Sofia (Redwood): Console has Admin Audit page and you can export CSVs or pull raw events from the API endpoint.
[07:49] Tomás (BlueCrest): question about cross-region replication for data residency: if we host EU-only, does any metadata hit US?
[07:58] Marcus (Redwood SE): we can ensure customer data stays in EU region for Private; hosted model may have some control-plane metadata in the US unless you choose Private VPC with regional-only config. we'll flag that with legal.
[08:14] Lena (BlueCrest): SAML attributes: do you need group IDs or group names?
[08:19] Marcus (Redwood SE): either, but consistent IDs are better. the mapping UI accepts both. if you send group names, avoid changing display names frequently.
[08:30] Priya (BlueCrest): cert fingerprint vs metadata — what do you recommend for rotation?
[08:35] Sofia (Redwood): we recommend using metadata URLs where possible so the IdP can rotate and we auto-refresh. if not possible, schedule cert uploads and set reminders 30/15/5 days out.
[08:50] Tomás (BlueCrest): about SCIM errors: what are typical failure modes?
[08:54] Marcus (Redwood SE): rate limits, missing required attributes (email), nested group formats, and stale tokens. we publish error codes; we'll include them in the guide.
[09:06] Erik (BlueCrest): do you support SAML+OIDC hybrid for machine auth?
[09:11] Marcus (Redwood SE): yes, OIDC for machines and SAML for workforce is a common pattern; our OIDC client credentials flow can mint short-lived tokens.
[09:26] Lena (BlueCrest): where in the onboarding doc do we find the SP ACS URL and the issuer?
[09:30] Sofia (Redwood): in the SSO guide we'll send; it's also visible in the Console under Integration -> SSO Settings. we'll include example metadata.
[09:40] Priya (BlueCrest): any notable security certifications relevant here? SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001?
[09:45] Sofia (Redwood): yes, Redwood publishes SOC 2 Type II report and ISO 27001 attestation. for Private we offer tighter contractual controls and additional artifact access for auditors.
[09:58] Tomás (BlueCrest): can you support SCIM for groups larger than 10k users? we have a big enterprise roster.
[10:05] Marcus (Redwood SE): yes, performance considerations apply — we recommend paginated delta sync and batch provisioning. we'll collaborate on a load test.
[10:18] Erik (BlueCrest): load test — will Redwood help run bench to ensure SCIM throughput?
[10:22] Marcus (Redwood SE): yes, SE-led load tests are part of Dedicated/Private onboarding. we'll define baseline throughput.
[10:30] Lena (BlueCrest): are there API rate-limits for SCIM?
[10:33] Marcus (Redwood SE): yes, default is modest; enterprise can raise limits or use burst windows. we'll provide the exact numbers in the guide.
[10:44] Sofia (Redwood): quick note on least-privilege: map groups to minimum role and rely on short-lived elevated roles for tasks. we can enable step-up auth for sensitive actions.
[10:57] Priya (BlueCrest): step-up auth? like require 2FA when someone tries to change production routing?
[11:02] Marcus (Redwood SE): exactly, we have configurable step-up policies for critical routes. requires SAML assertions that include MFA claims or OIDC MFA contexts.
[11:18] Tomás (BlueCrest): what's the mechanism for session revocation if a user is compromised?
[11:23] Marcus (Redwood SE): immediate session revoke via SCIM deprovision call, revoke tokens API, and audit entries produced. also we have a revoke all sessions endpoint.
[11:35] Erik (BlueCrest): can we auto-rotate service account keys?
[11:39] Sofia (Redwood): yes via our API combined with your vault automation. we can provide sample scripts.
[11:48] Priya (BlueCrest): what about SAML assertions size limits? large number of groups can blow up assertions. suggestions?
[11:53] Marcus (Redwood SE): prefer group membership by group ID and keep group counts minimal in the assertion; use SCIM for large group management.
[12:06] Lena (BlueCrest): audit logs again: can you filter by user, action, or resource?
[12:10] Marcus (Redwood SE): yes, queryable by user, event type, resource id, and timestamps. you'll get search and raw export.
[12:19] Tomás (BlueCrest): about metadata sharing, I can produce Okta metadata. will you validate on a staging IdP?
[12:25] Sofia (Redwood): yes, Marcus will validate and we can set up a quick test tenant for you.
[12:30] Marcus (Redwood SE): primary test flow: 1) we ingest metadata; 2) set temporary rule mappings; 3) Okta SCIM token test; 4) provision sample user and group; 5) validate role mapping and login.
[12:45] Erik (BlueCrest): one more on compliance: do you allow us to bring an auditor in to interview?
[12:50] Sofia (Redwood): yes, for enterprise customers we allow auditor access under NDA and scoped sessions. we can coordinate.
[13:00] Priya (BlueCrest): any gotchas for GDPR data subject requests?
[13:05] Marcus (Redwood SE): we can support data exports and deletions for user data; for Private you control retention and disposal. we'll include DSAR process in the guide.
[13:18] Lena (BlueCrest): cross-tenant entanglement: ensure no shared logs across tenants?
[13:23] Sofia (Redwood): tenancy separation is strict in Private; hosted is multi-tenant but logically isolated and we maintain controls to ensure no cross-tenant leakage.
[13:38] Tomás (BlueCrest): sample timeline to go from PoC to prod?
[13:42] Sofia (Redwood): PoC (2–4 weeks) for SSO/SCIM + basic RBAC tests; then Dedicated/Private onboarding (4–8 weeks) depending on custom KMS work and audit packaging.
[14:00] Marcus (Redwood SE): i'll produce a recording and a step-by-step SCIM mapping demo so you can replay the exact mapping flow.
[14:10] Sofia (Redwood): i'll send the checklist and pricing. also we'll add a note on the cert auto-rollover support.
[14:18] Lena (BlueCrest): ok, action items noted. thanks all.
[14:22] Erik (BlueCrest): will the SCIM demo cover error codes?
[14:25] Marcus (Redwood SE): yes, common error codes and troubleshooting steps included.
[14:32] Priya (BlueCrest): do we need to sign anything else for Private?
[14:36] Sofia (Redwood): standard enterprise contract + a data processing addendum for GDPR and an addendum for compliance artifacts; we'll loop legal once you confirm interest.
[14:46] Tomás (BlueCrest): we'll aim to provide metadata by 12/08 and pick a week in mid-December for a hands-on test.
[14:52] Sofia (Redwood): perfect. final quick recap?
[15:00] Sofia (Redwood): recap: Redwood to share SSO/SCIM guide, Marcus to produce SCIM demo, BlueCrest to provide Okta metadata and group list, we'll schedule a staging test week of 12/15, discuss audit retention and BYOK next.
[15:18] Lena (BlueCrest): closing note: we'll likely need the SOC2 artifact package, please include that.
[15:23] Sofia (Redwood): will do. thanks everyone.

End of transcript.
